decisions.reason: The operator training programme builds on the firm's established service offer and had its own website page in two consecutive years, so dropping it would write off a visible commitment at little saving.
The fourth rotary axis accessory extends the core machine line, and as a low-cost add-on it can be kept, with any weak sales put down to temporary market conditions.

Hybrid additive post-processing is far from the firm's established offer and was only mentioned on the website, so little public commitment has to be justified and the resources can go to the core business.

The high-speed CNC milling machine sits at the centre of the firm's identity and announced direction, and it carries heavy R&D investment and a dedicated page, so the firm is strongly committed to it.
The automatic tool change system is integral to the firm's machine platform and was visibly presented on its own page, so dropping it would expose the investment as a mistake.
